verses.he: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁמַֽע־נָ֣א אִיּ֣וֹב מִלָּ֑י וְֽכָל־דְּבָרַ֥י הַאֲזִֽינָה׃
verses.en: Howbeit, Job, I pray thee, hear my speech, And hearken to all my words.

verses.he: הִנֵּה־נָ֭א פָּתַ֣חְתִּי פִ֑י דִּבְּרָ֖ה לְשׁוֹנִ֣י בְחִכִּֽי׃
verses.en: Behold now, I have opened my mouth, My tongue hath spoken in my mouth.

verses.he: יֹֽשֶׁר־לִבִּ֥י אֲמָרָ֑י וְדַ֥עַת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י בָּר֥וּר מִלֵּֽלוּ׃
verses.en: My words shall utter the uprightness of my heart; And that which my lips know they shall speak sincerely.

verses.he: רֽוּחַ־אֵ֥ל עָשָׂ֑תְנִי וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּחַיֵּֽנִי׃
verses.en: The spirit of God hath made me, And the breath of the Almighty given me life.

verses.he: אִם־תּוּכַ֥ל הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי עֶרְכָ֥ה לְ֝פָנַ֗י הִתְיַצָּֽבָה׃
verses.en: If thou canst, answer thou me, Set thy words in order before me, stand forth.

verses.he: הֵן־אֲנִ֣י כְפִ֣יךָ לָאֵ֑ל מֵ֝חֹ֗מֶר קֹרַ֥צְתִּי גַם־אָֽנִי׃
verses.en: Behold, I am toward God even as thou art; I also am formed out of the clay.

verses.he: הִנֵּ֣ה אֵ֭מָתִי לֹ֣א תְבַעֲתֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝אַכְפִּ֗י עָלֶ֥יךָ לֹא־יִכְבָּֽד׃
verses.en: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, Neither shall my pressure be heavy upon thee.

verses.he: אַ֭ךְ אָמַ֣רְתָּ בְאָזְנָ֑י וְק֖וֹל מִלִּ֣ין אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.en: Surely thou hast spoken in my hearing, And I have heard the voice of thy words;

verses.he: זַ֥ךְ אֲנִ֗י בְּֽלִ֫י פָ֥שַׁע חַ֥ף אָנֹכִ֑י וְלֹ֖א עָו‍ֹ֣ן לִֽי׃
verses.en: ’I am clean, without transgression, I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me;

verses.he: הֵ֣ן תְּ֭נוּאוֹת עָלַ֣י יִמְצָ֑א יַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Behold, He findeth occasions against me, He counteth me for His enemy;

verses.he: יָשֵׂ֣ם בַּסַּ֣ד רַגְלָ֑י יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כָּל־אָרְחֹתָֽי׃
verses.en: He putteth my feet in the stocks, He marketh all my paths.’ .

verses.he: הֶן־זֹ֣את לֹא־צָדַ֣קְתָּ אֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־יִרְבֶּ֥ה אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ מֵאֱנֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: Behold, I answer thee: In this thou art not right, That God is too great for man;

verses.he: מַ֭דּוּעַ אֵלָ֣יו רִיב֑וֹתָ כִּ֥י כָל־דְּ֝בָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א־יַעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.en: Why hast thou striven against Him? Seeing that He will not answer any of his words.

verses.he: כִּֽי־בְאַחַ֥ת יְדַבֶּר־אֵ֑ל וּ֝בִשְׁתַּ֗יִם לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: For God speaketh in one way, Yea in two, though man perceiveth it not.

verses.he: בַּחֲל֤וֹם׀ חֶזְי֬וֹן לַ֗יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֣ל תַּ֭רְדֵּמָה עַל־אֲנָשִׁ֑ים בִּ֝תְנוּמ֗וֹת עֲלֵ֣י מִשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.en: In a dream, in a vision of the night, When deep sleep falleth upon men, In slumberings upon the bed;

verses.he: אָ֣ז יִ֭גְלֶה אֹ֣זֶן אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וּבְמֹ֖סָרָ֣ם יַחְתֹּֽם׃
verses.en: Then He openeth the ears of men, And by their chastisement sealeth the decree,

verses.he: לְ֭הָסִיר אָדָ֣ם מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְגֵוָ֖ה מִגֶּ֣בֶר יְכַסֶּֽה׃
verses.en: That men may put away their purpose, And that He may hide pride from man;

verses.he: יַחְשֹׂ֣ךְ נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁ֑חַת וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ מֵעֲבֹ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁלַח׃
verses.en: That He may keep back his soul from the pit, And his life from perishing by the sword.

verses.he: וְהוּכַ֣ח בְּ֭מַכְאוֹב עַל־מִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ וריב [וְר֖וֹב] עֲצָמָ֣יו אֵתָֽן׃
verses.en: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, And all his bones grow stiff;

verses.he: וְזִֽהֲמַ֣תּוּ חַיָּת֣וֹ לָ֑חֶם וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ מַאֲכַ֥ל תַּאֲוָֽה׃
verses.en: So that his life maketh him to abhor bread, And his soul dainty food.

verses.he: יִ֣כֶל בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מֵרֹ֑אִי ושפי [וְשֻׁפּ֥וּ] עַ֝צְמוֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א רֻאּֽוּ׃
verses.en: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; And his bones corrode to unsightliness.

verses.he: וַתִּקְרַ֣ב לַשַּׁ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ לַֽמְמִתִֽים׃
verses.en: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the pit, And his life to the destroyers.

verses.he: אִם־יֵ֤שׁ עָלָ֨יו׀ מַלְאָ֗ךְ מֵלִ֗יץ אֶחָ֥ד מִנִּי־אָ֑לֶף לְהַגִּ֖יד לְאָדָ֣ם יָשְׁרֽוֹ׃
verses.en: If there be for him an angel, An intercessor, one among a thousand, To vouch for a man’s uprightness;

verses.he: וַיְחֻנֶּ֗נּוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פְּ֭דָעֵהוּ מֵרֶ֥דֶת שָׁ֗חַת מָצָ֥אתִי כֹֽפֶר׃
verses.en: Then He is gracious unto him, and saith: ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’

verses.he: רֻֽטֲפַ֣שׁ בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מִנֹּ֑עַר יָ֝שׁ֗וּב לִימֵ֥י עֲלוּמָֽיו׃
verses.en: His flesh is tenderer than a child’s; He returneth to the days of his youth;

verses.he: יֶעְתַּ֤ר אֶל־אֱל֨וֹהַּ׀ וַיִּרְצֵ֗הוּ וַיַּ֣רְא פָּ֭נָיו בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה וַיָּ֥שֶׁב לֶ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He prayeth unto God, and He is favourable unto him; So that he seeth His face with joy; And He restoreth unto man his righteousness.

verses.he: יָשֹׁ֤ר׀ עַל־אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיֹּ֗אמֶר חָ֭טָאתִי וְיָשָׁ֥ר הֶעֱוֵ֗יתִי וְלֹא־שָׁ֥וָה לִֽי׃
verses.en: He cometh before men, and saith: ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, And it profited me not.’

verses.he: פָּדָ֣ה נפשי [נַ֭פְשׁוֹ] מֵעֲבֹ֣ר בַּשָּׁ֑חַת וחיתי [וְ֝חַיָּתוֹ] בָּא֥וֹר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.en: So He redeemeth his soul from going into the pit, And his life beholdeth the light.

verses.he: הֶן־כָּל־אֵ֭לֶּה יִפְעַל־אֵ֑ל פַּעֲמַ֖יִם שָׁל֣וֹשׁ עִם־גָּֽבֶר׃
verses.en: Lo, all these things doth God work, Twice, yea thrice, with a man,

verses.he: לְהָשִׁ֣יב נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁ֑חַת לֵ֝א֗וֹר בְּא֣וֹר הַֽחַיִּים׃
verses.en: To bring back his soul from the pit, That he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

verses.he: הַקְשֵׁ֖ב אִיּ֥וֹב שְֽׁמַֽע־לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וְאָנֹכִ֥י אֲדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.en: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me; Hold thy peace, and I will speak.

verses.he: אִם־יֵשׁ־מִלִּ֥ין הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי דַּ֝בֵּ֗ר כִּֽי־חָפַ֥צְתִּי צַדְּקֶֽךָּ׃
verses.en: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me; Speak, for I desire to justify thee.

verses.he: אִם־אַ֭יִן אַתָּ֥ה שְֽׁמַֽע־לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וַאֲאַלֶּפְךָ֥ חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.en: If not, hearken thou unto me; Hold thy peace, and I will teach thee wisdom.
